optimization_target: Repeated positive-occurrence compatibility over already computed finite reachable sets.
allowed_change: Replace repeated first-passage recomputation inside sampling replicates with integer bitset subset tests.

cxx_decision.rule: Implement C++ only if optimized Python fast backend still exceeds 60 s on the same CI target workload.
cxx_decision.rationale: The original 75.865 s crossed the provisional threshold, but avoid a language port when redundant Python recomputation is sufficient to remove the bottleneck.
